verdict.rationale: Superset has a first-class task primitive that can be managed through the SDK, CLI and MCP server, and the SDK explicitly supports scripted task creation and triage. Docs also mention turning comments on shared agent-created designs and reports into updates. However, nothing shows ingesting user feedback submissions and turning them into structured tasks with proposed scope; a PM would have to script that pipeline themselves, likely prompting an agent to draft the scope. Missing for 10: native feedback intake, automatic conversion of feedback into structured tasks, proposed-scope/spec generation, and any hands-on evidence of a PM workflow.
